title: A Next.js route that calls OpenAI or Anthropic with no auth or rate limit lets anyone spend your API credits
symptoms: The AI route answers requests that carry no session cookie
AI provider usage grows much faster than your number of real users
cause: Route Handlers are public HTTP endpoints that any client can call, not only your own pages. A handler that passes the request body to a paid model with your server key spends money on every call, whoever makes it.
fix: Check the user's session at the top of the handler and return 401 without one, then apply a per-user or per-IP rate limit and return 429 when it is hit. Also turn on any rate limiting your host provides, and set a hard spend limit with the AI provider as a backstop.
affected: Next.js Route Handlers and Pages Router API Routes that call a paid AI API
